evals.prompt: Construct an atomic `marketplace-catalog` `StartChangeSet` design for a 3-year (`P36M`) `$360,000` Private Offer targeted to buyer account `123456789012` with three `$120,000` annual **Flexible Payment Scheduler (FPS)** invoices, custom metered overage rates, Standard Contract (SCMP) legal terms, and a 30-day buyer acceptance deadline.
evals.expected_output: Designs a single atomic `us-east-1` `StartChangeSet` (`Catalog='AWSMarketplace'`) sequencing all 8 modular offer change types using intra-changeset `ChangeName` references (`$CreateOffer` -> `Entity.Identifier`): (1) `CreateOffer` (`ProductId`), (2) `UpdateInformation`, (3) `UpdateTargeting` (`PositiveTargeting.BuyerAccounts: ['123456789012']`), (4) `UpdatePricingTerms` combining `ConfigurableUpfrontPricingTerm` + `UsageBasedPricingTerm` + **`PaymentScheduleTerm` (FPS)** with three `$120,000` `ChargeDate`/`ChargeAmount` milestones, (5) `UpdateLegalTerms` (`StandardEula` / **SCMP**), (6) `UpdateValidityTerms` (`AgreementDuration: 'P36M'`), (7) `UpdateAvailability` (`AvailabilityEndDate` +30 days), and (8) `ReleaseOffer`.
expectations: Activates the aws-marketplace-private-offers-and-agreements skill

Includes all 8 modular Private Offer change types (`CreateOffer`, `UpdateInformation`, `UpdateTargeting`, `UpdatePricingTerms`, `UpdateLegalTerms`, `UpdateValidityTerms`, `UpdateAvailability`, `ReleaseOffer`) in `us-east-1`
Configures `PaymentScheduleTerm` (Flexible Payment Scheduler with 3 x `$120,000` installments) + `ConfigurableUpfrontPricingTerm`/`UsageBasedPricingTerm` + SCMP legal terms + `P36M` validity

evals.expected_output: Resolves all three errors: (1) pin `marketplace-catalog` and `marketplace-agreement` calls strictly to **`us-east-1`**; (2) assign a `ChangeName` (e.g., `"ChangeName": "NewOffer"`) on the `CreateOffer` object and reference **`"Identifier": "$NewOffer"`** in all subsequent `Update*` and `ReleaseOffer` entries within the same atomic `StartChangeSet`; and (3) fix **`PaymentScheduleTerm` (FPS)** invariants — installment `ChargeAmount`s must reconcile cleanly with total contract value (`$75k + $75k + $40k = $190k != $200k` mismatch) and every `ChargeDate` **must fall within the agreement validity period** (never after `AgreementEndDate`).
expectations: Activates the aws-marketplace-private-offers-and-agreements skill
Pins `marketplace-catalog` to `us-east-1` and uses intra-changeset `ChangeName` (`"$NewOffer"`) in `Entity.Identifier` across chained `CreateOffer` -> `Update*` -> `ReleaseOffer` steps
Identifies both `PaymentScheduleTerm` validation errors: installment sum mismatch (`$190,000` vs `$200,000`) and `ChargeDate` falling past `AgreementEndDate`

evals.prompt: Verify via AWS Marketplace documentation MCP tools: (1) the difference between **Standard Contract for AWS Marketplace (SCMP)** and **Enterprise Contract for AWS Marketplace (ECMP)** in `UpdateLegalTerms`, and (2) how **Future-Dated Agreements** work when a buyer accepts a Private Offer today whose service start date is 60 days in the future.
evals.expected_output: Consults `awsknowledge` / `aws-mcp` documentation tools with zero raw `aws` CLI commands and explains: (1) **SCMP (`StandardEula`)** is AWS Marketplace's standardized click-through EULA for fast commercial procurement without redlining, whereas **ECMP** is the pre-negotiated multi-party enterprise contract framework (with optional addendum) designed for large regulated enterprise buyers and participating ISVs (alongside custom seller EULA S3 PDF attachments); and (2) **Future-Dated Agreements** set explicit `AgreementStartDate` and `AgreementEndDate` in `UpdateValidityTerms` (instead of immediate-on-acceptance duration), allowing the buyer to accept the Private Offer today while entitlements/billing activate automatically on the future `AgreementStartDate`.
expectations: Activates the aws-marketplace-private-offers-and-agreements skill and consults `awsknowledge` / `aws-mcp` documentation tools with zero raw `aws` CLI commands
Distinguishes SCMP (`StandardEula`), ECMP (pre-negotiated enterprise contract framework), and custom seller EULA attachments in `UpdateLegalTerms`
Explains Future-Dated Agreements using explicit future `AgreementStartDate` + `AgreementEndDate` in `UpdateValidityTerms`
